==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) As a treat we hired some werewolf women massage therapists. (The last time I encountered werewolves was in a dream on 07/10/2025, when they were trying to recruit me to a traveling hero's guild. I refused at the time, but now I am essentially a part of my own traveling hero's guild on a larger scale. The werewolf women massage therapists are, of course, a different group of werewolves.) They wanted rare moon rocks for their services. (We actually took them to a mystical moon world for them to find the rocks they were looking for, as we didn't have any on hand.) (The last time I had a crazy dream related to the moon was on 03/23/2025. In that dream, trees from the moon created a plant creature called the Undergrowth that I wanted to protect. Other people wanted to control the Undergrowth in that dream. It is interesting that in the Undergrowth dream and in this dream with the werewolves, that I am not inherently against creatures born from the moon.) The rocks turned them into hostile kaiju and we were forced to flee. (The last time I encountered a kaiju was in a dream on 08/02/2025. That was a much wilder threat and one that at the time couldn't be ignored.)
